chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah and al-Fuḍayl, from one of the two of them, peace be upon him, who said:

The woman in nifās refrains from salat (prayer) for the days of her menstrual periods during which she used to remain [in menstruation]; then she performs ghusl and prays, just as the mustaḥāḍah performs ghusl.

key_terms.أَقْرَائِهَا: her menstrual periods or habitual cycles
key_terms.أَيَّامَ: the number of days or period of time
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ: the woman with istiḥāḍah, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.تَغْتَسِلُ: she performs ghusl, the ritual bath

ai.seo_question: How many days does a woman in nifās leave salat (prayer) before performing ghusl and resuming worship?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding nifās after childbirth. It states that the woman leaves salat (prayer) for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, then performs ghusl and resumes prayer in the manner of the mustaḥāḍah.
